semaglutide.title: Semaglutide acts on one receptor. What happens depends on the organ.
semaglutide.detail: How it works in one cell, then in each organ, and how well each effect is shown.

pancreas.effect: More insulin when blood sugar is high, and less glucagon.

brain.effect: Less hunger: adults with obesity ate about a third less at a test lunch.

stomach.effect: Food leaves the stomach a little more slowly after a meal. This fades with time.

fat.effect: A body scan of 140 adults with obesity or overweight showed that most weight lost was fat.

muscle.effect: In 140 adults with obesity or overweight, lean mass, which includes muscle, fell too, but less than fat.
muscle.note: what this means for strength in older or frail people.

tirzepatide.title: Tirzepatide acts on two receptors. What happens depends on the organ.
tirzepatide.detail: How it works in one cell, then in each organ, and how well each effect is shown.

pancreas.effect: More insulin when blood sugar is high, and less glucagon.

brain.effect: Less hunger: adults with type 2 diabetes ate less at a test lunch.
brain.note: which brain cells it reaches, and what GIP adds there.

stomach.effect: Food leaves the stomach more slowly at first. This fades over time.

fat.effect: A body scan of adults with obesity or overweight showed that most weight lost was fat.
fat.note: through the GIP receptor, fat tissue took up more sugar, so insulin worked better.

muscle.effect: In adults with obesity or overweight, lean mass, which includes muscle, fell too, but less than fat.
muscle.note: whether this matters for strength and falls in older people.

retatrutide.title: Retatrutide acts on three receptors. What happens depends on the organ.
retatrutide.detail: How it works in one cell, then in each organ, and how well each effect is shown.

pancreas.effect: In all published diabetes trials, blood sugar fell.

brain.effect: Adults with type 2 diabetes on higher doses felt less hungry than those on placebo.
brain.note: which brain cells take part, from studies of related medicines.

stomach.effect: Feeling sick and diarrhoea were the most common side effects.
stomach.note: a short report by the maker says food leaves the stomach more slowly.

liver.effect: In 98 adults with obesity and fatty liver, liver fat fell up to four-fifths, partly through weight loss.
liver.note: it worked on liver cells through the glucagon receptor.

fat.effect: In adults with type 2 diabetes, higher doses cut body fat by about a quarter in 36 weeks.
fat.note: mice burned more energy. Results in people are not published yet.

muscle.effect: Adults with type 2 diabetes lost lean mass too. The maker called the share typical of obesity drugs.
muscle.note: how much of it was muscle, and what happens to strength.
